name: app.managebetcodes/managebetcodes-mcp
title: Manage Bet Codes
description: Convert, view, split, merge and track betting codes across bookmakers.

tools.name: mbc_list_bookmakers
tools.description: List all 45 supported bookmakers with their canonical keys, aliases, code format hints, and capability flags (supports_book, supports_search, supports_tracking, supports_split, conversion_mode, countries). Costs 0 credits. Note: bare '1xbet' and 'afropari' are retired; use '1xng'/'1xglobal' and 'afropari_ng'/'afropari_global'.

tools.name: mbc_list_markets
tools.description: List all canonical betting markets (1X2, Over/Under, Both Teams To Score, Double Chance, Asian Handicap, European Handicap, totals) and their valid outcome names for resolving and booking games. Names only; a bookmaker may list only some of them. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_get_usage
tools.description: Read the caller's active plan, key charge_order, API credits (monthly plan plus never-expiring packs), regular daily credits, rate limit windows, and active jobs and tracks. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip
tools.description: Load a booking code on a bookmaker and return all games, markets, outcomes, odds, live scores, kickoff times, and total odds. Costs 1 credit after a successful read; failed lookups cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip_image
tools.description: Render a branded PNG slip image for a booking code on a bookmaker. Returns an MCP ImageContent block (image/png) plus a summary. Costs 2 credits after a successful render; failed renders cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_convert_code
tools.description: Convert a booking code from one source bookmaker to 1 target bookmaker or a synchronous batch of up to 6 target bookmakers. Costs 2 credits per target that produces a code; failed targets are automatically refunded. To convert to all bookmakers at once (up to 29), use mbc_convert_to_all.

to_bookmakers.description: Target bookmaker key/alias or list of 1 to 6 targets (e.g. '1xng' or ['1xng', 'bet9ja', 'msport']).

tools.name: mbc_convert_to_all
tools.description: Convert one booking code to all 29 default target bookmakers at once (up to 29 target bookmakers: SportyBet, 1xBet Global, 1xBet NG, MSport, Paripesa, 22Bet, Megapari, 888starz, Afropari NG, Afropari Global, Betwinner, Melbet, Helabet, Fastpari, Xparibet, Goldpari, 1xBit, WinWinBet, DBBet, Paripulse, BetJam, Planbet, Linebet, Luckypari, Bet9ja, BetKing, Football.com, Betway, FanSport), or pass a custom targets subset. Uses per-family concurrency lanes. Costs 2 credits per successful target code; failed targets cost 0 credits. Country variants are opt-in through the targets list.

targets.description: Optional list of target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert to all eligible bookmakers.

include_card.description: Set true to also render a PNG share card with all converted codes (1080 px wide, as tall as the content).

tools.name: mbc_bulk_convert
tools.description: Convert 2 to 4 source booking codes synchronously across all or selected target bookmakers in one batch (each slip's own source bookmaker is automatically excluded from its targets). Costs 2 credits per successful (code, target) pair; failed pairs cost 0 credits. For 5 to 20 source codes, use mbc_manage_jobs_and_history with action='create_job' and kind='convert'.

codes.description: 2 to 4 source slips to bulk convert.

targets.description: Optional target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert each slip to all eligible bookmakers.

include_card.description: Set true to render a combined PNG share card containing all slips (1080 px wide, as tall as the content).

tools.name: mbc_split_code
tools.description: Divide one booking code into 2 to 20 smaller codes on the same bookmaker so every game lands in exactly one new code. Supports 4 split methods: 'equal' (spread games evenly across codes), 'by_batches' (keep consecutive games together in each code), 'target_odds' (group games to reach a chosen combined odds per code), and 'custom' (set exact game counts per output code). Supports 2 game orders: 'mixed' (keep original slip order) and 'by_start_time' (earliest games first, latest games last). Costs 2 credits plus 1 credit per extra created code; unused parts are refunded.

order.description: Game order: 'mixed' (original slip order) or 'by_start_time' (sorted by kickoff).

count.description: Number of output codes (2 to 20) when method is 'equal' or 'by_batches'.

target_odds.description: Target combined odds per output code (e.g. 5.0) when method is 'target_odds'.

counts.description: Exact game count for each output code (must sum to total games on the slip) when method is 'custom'.

tools.name: mbc_merge_codes
tools.description: Combine 2 to 30 booking codes (from the same or different bookmakers) into one deduplicated booking code on a target bookmaker. Reports any skipped, dropped, or conflicting games. Costs 2 credits for the first code, plus 1 credit for each other code on the target bookmaker and 2 credits for each code from another bookmaker; refunded if no code is created.

target.description: Target bookmaker key or alias (defaults to the first pair's bookmaker).

tools.name: mbc_search_events
tools.description: Search up to 20 team or head-to-head match queries ('Arsenal vs Chelsea', 'Real Madrid') on a bookmaker. Returns event IDs, kickoff times, confidence ('exact' or 'fuzzy'), and top canonical markets. Spends 1 work unit per query against the daily cap. Costs 0 credits.

q.description: Team name ('Arsenal') or head-to-head ('Arsenal vs Chelsea').

sport.description: Sport filter (default 'football'; pass 'all' for all sports).

include_markets.description: Include top canonical markets on each event (default true).

market_filter.description: Optional canonical market names to filter (e.g. ['1X2', 'Over/Under']).

tools.name: mbc_get_event_markets
tools.description: Fetch markets, lines, outcomes, and live odds for one event_id on a bookmaker. Start with names_only=true to learn the market names, then request one or more names with market= or narrow with q=. view=all adds native markets (canonical: false) and needs market= or q=. Each outcome carries a key for mbc_resolve_picks. Repeat market= to read several names in one call; the response lists the missing names in not_found. Spends 1 work unit per call against the daily cap. Costs 0 credits.

view.description: canonical (default) or all. all requires market= or q=.

market.description: Full market name (exact, case-insensitive) or a substring. Repeat it to request several names.

q.description: Substring match against every canonical and native market name.

names_only.description: Return the names only, with no outcomes or prices. The list is complete, not capped.

tools.name: mbc_resolve_picks
tools.description: Validate 1 to 50 games (team names or event_ids plus canonical market, outcome, and optional line/odds) on a target bookmaker and create a 10-minute plan_id for mbc_book_code. Returns per-game status ('resolved', 'ambiguous', 'not_found', 'market_missing', 'odds_changed', 'not_bookable'). Spends 1 work unit per pick against the daily cap. Costs 0 credits.

key.description: Selection key from mbc_get_event_markets. Send it with event_id in the same pick.

market.description: Canonical market (e.g. '1X2', 'Over/Under', 'Both Teams To Score', 'Double Chance').

strict.description: Require all games to resolve (default true).

accept_odds_change.description: Accept moved odds beyond 1% tolerance (default false).

tools.name: mbc_book_code
tools.description: Mint a new verified booking code on 1 to 6 target bookmakers from either a plan_id (from mbc_resolve_picks) or direct picks. A key pick fans out within its family directly, and across families when bookmaker names the brand that minted the key. Costs 2 credits per target code created; refunded if no code is created.

bookmaker.description: Bookmaker key or alias. For a key pick that fans out to another family, this is the bookmaker that minted the key; include home_team and away_team when the target event_id differs.

picks.description: Direct game picks when booking without a plan_id. Each pick carries event_id plus either key or market and outcome.

to.description: Optional fan-out list of 1 to 6 target bookmakers.

strict.description: All games must resolve or no code is created (default true).

accept_odds_change.description: Allow booking if odds moved since resolution (default false).

tools.name: mbc_manage_tracking
tools.description: Manage live match tracking for SportyBet, Football.com, and Betway slips. Actions: 'start' (costs 1 credit; mode 'ticket' fast-fails on a cut, 'game' tracks to the end), 'get' (0 credits), 'list' (0 credits), 'stop' (0 credits).

mode.description: 'ticket' (fast-fail on a losing game) or 'game' (track all games to the end).

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL on port 443/8443 for 'start'.

tools.name: mbc_manage_jobs_and_history
tools.description: Create, inspect, list, or cancel async jobs (for >6 targets or up to 20 source codes, requires Developer/Scale/Business API plan), or query past conversion history and book history (0 credits for reads).

job_id.description: Job ID 'job_...' for get_job or cancel_job.

row_id.description: History ID ('hl_...') or Book ID for get_history or get_book.
